info.title: AMLOK API
info.description: AMLOK API: borrower connections, Insights origination, immutable risk packages and Signal monitoring. Use your institution-issued API origin.

parameters.name: X-AMLOK-Sandbox-Scenario

post.description: Register a business or consumer borrower. Registration records institution-supplied identity; it does not assert successful KYB or KYC. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: borrowers:write.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl --request POST --fail-with-body --max-time 30 \
  "${AMLOK_API_BASE_URL}/v1/borrowers" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer ${AMLOK_API_KEY}" \
  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
  --header 'Idempotency-Key: createBorrower-synthetic-0042' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"type":"business","business":{"legal_name":"Synthetic Borrower Inc.","incorporation_country":"CA","client_reference":"LOS-B-0042"}}'

import os
import requests

headers = {'Accept': 'application/json', 'Idempotency-Key': 'createBorrower-synthetic-0042', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + os.environ["AMLOK_API_KEY"]
response = requests.request('POST', os.environ["AMLOK_API_BASE_URL"] + '/v1/borrowers', headers=headers, json={'type': 'business', 'business': {'legal_name': 'Synthetic Borrower Inc.', 'incorporation_country': 'CA', 'client_reference': 'LOS-B-0042'}}, timeout=30, allow_redirects=False)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl --request GET --fail-with-body --max-time 30 \
  "${AMLOK_API_BASE_URL}/v1/configuration" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer ${AMLOK_API_KEY}" \
  --header 'Accept: application/json'

import os
import requests

headers = {'Accept': 'application/json'}
headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + os.environ["AMLOK_API_KEY"]
response = requests.request('GET', os.environ["AMLOK_API_BASE_URL"] + '/v1/configuration', headers=headers, timeout=30, allow_redirects=False)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())

FinancialStatement.description: Normalized statements with hierarchy and sourced adjustments. Do not sum both a subtotal and its children. Adjustments never overwrite source statements.

DebtObligation.description: Resolved obligations and exact required payments, including proposed exposure. Inferred recurring debits do not prove outstanding principal, contract rate or complete liabilities. Schedules use stated currency; rate is a fraction.

IncomeStream.description: Independent gross and net income evidence. Deposits alone establish neither pretax income nor an employment relationship. Monthly conversion: weekly ×52/12, biweekly ×26/12, semimonthly ×2; disclose irregular-period method.

Reconciliation.description: Bridge: adjusted_left_total = left_total + signed adjustments; residual = adjusted_left_total - right_total. Matched requires abs(residual) <= nonnegative tolerance plus complete comparable populations. Differences are not automatically fraud.

ConcentrationSegment.description: Buckets plus unallocated_amount reconcile to total. Shares use the same positive denominator. Pseudonymous counterparties are limited to the authorized borrower scope; no unrelated customer data.

RiskProjection.description: Conditional forecast under explicit parameter assumptions, not a promise or default probability. A statistical interval needs calibration evidence; a deterministic stress range is not a confidence interval. Each output identifies its horizon, currency and unit.

RiskBenchmark.description: Only an entitled, relevant, documented cohort can yield a percentile. No invented peers, universal cutoffs or source-free industry rankings.

RiskModelOutput.description: Only entitled, validated outputs applicable to this borrower/population. Provider scores retain their original model and scale. Never substitute a heuristic or deterministic scenario for a calibrated PD/LGD. Score scale and target are documented by validation_reference.

RiskChange.description: Only compare compatible calculation versions, scope, units, currency, observation windows and evidence quality. relative_delta is null with zero/nonpositive baseline; absolute_delta remains numeric when valid.

CollateralAsset.description: Dated asset valuation, ownership and encumbrance evidence. Eligible value is a justified assessment, not an enforceability guarantee. Unknown liens or stale valuations are explicit limitations; do not report zero liens from an absent search.

BorrowerRelationship.description: An authorized borrower relationship with its basis and observation date. IDs are scoped references; an inferred relationship is never represented as verified ownership. No unrelated institution identity graph.

CreditReportAssessment.description: Entitled matched bureau evidence retains provider/model/score scale, pull date and disputes. A missing report is unavailable, not a clean credit record. No cross-model score averaging. Linked obligations are resolved without double-counting.

TaxObligation.description: Separate tax declaration, filing, assessment and payment evidence. Unknown records cannot establish compliance or arrears. Duplicate tax obligations already in the debt schedule are linked in evidence rather than charged twice.
